# Vendored eooo theme

`eooo-io-theme-0.1.0.tgz` is an exact `npm pack` snapshot of the canonical
eooo-io UI package at the start of the Tessera desktop workbench
implementation.

- Package: `@eooo-io/theme@0.1.0`
- npm shasum: `597446ef0ea35d2e148044c4e4bf80e6aca85021`
- Reason: the package declared by the UI repository was not retrievable from
  GitHub Packages on 2026-07-14. Vendoring preserves the canonical package
  boundary without copying or silently modifying its tokens.

Replace this tarball with the published dependency when package read access is
available. Do not edit the tokens inside Tessera.
